answer_1.quote: Long-form question answering (LFQA) integrates the retrieval component of open-domain QA... with a text generation component to produce paragraph-length answers.

answer_2.quote: Answer quality is measured by the maximum overlap of generations with a set of gold answers in terms of unigram F1 score and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: we perform additional human A/B testing on the output of Random and Predicted. Specifically, we ask human volunteers to choose between answers generated by the two systems...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose which generation (1) answered the question better / which answer was more relevant to the question; (2) was more coherent / had less repetition; (3) was more factually correct.
